name: Naturhotel Waldklause
beschreibung: The Naturhotel Waldklause is located in Längenfeld in the Ötztal, surrounded by the Tiroler mountain backdrop. The architectural style predominantly uses regional woods and natural stone, which creates a warm atmosphere. The wellness area includes several saunas, a steam bath, and a relaxation room with mountain views. The accommodation appeals to guests seeking relaxation who appreciate the tranquility of nature. The cuisine focuses on local products and offers seasonal Tiroler dishes. Hiking trails and ski areas are directly accessible from the hotel. The rooms are kept simple and furnished with natural materials. A garden with a lawn for sunbathing and a fitness room are available.
